note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. Two identical, fictional archive rooms: only the supplied state of the file differs (A active ●, B archived ◆). 'Archived' is only another shelf block in this example; nothing states a retention period, an access or destruction rule, an archiving procedure, a time span, a consequence or a winner.
